task.object: Randomized component-stratified Sobol quadrature using the unchanged regularized defensive proposal
deliverables: Frozen settings, actual budgets and all-row toy NPZ; no GP pilot

assumptions: Every proposal component has known normalized density and positive full weight, and the full mixture is used in the denominator.
Independent scrambled Sobol randomizations identify the replicates used for variance estimation.
All original center strata and all proposal components including the defensive prior are retained.
Ratio uncertainty uses a finite-R delta approximation; row ESS is descriptive only.
mathematical_context.domain: Unit-cube prior coordinates mapped to finite logit z; each conditional center stratum has its own frozen full proposal.

precision.target_tolerance: Exact toy integral/weight identities <=1e-14 absolute; density check <=1e-12; fixed stochastic toy checks within six scramble SE; finite-R calibration remains descriptive.

mathematica.existence_evidence: Task explicitly uses the existing NumPy/SciPy proposal and Sobol implementation.
mathematica.availability_evidence: No CAS needed or invoked; no callable Wolfram evaluator advertised.

sagemath.existence_evidence: No alternate symbolic implementation is required for this fixed numerical prototype.
sagemath.availability_evidence: Existing numerical environment used without installs.

candidate_implementations: NumPy pairwise scramble integration and sample covariance
python.existence_evidence: qmc_importance.py and check_toys.py executed; 20 final checks passed with full retained toy report.
python.availability_evidence: Live Python from mica2-slowgp environment; API signature verified; toy run completes in 2.68 seconds.

decision.selection_reason: Use SciPy randomized Sobol and inverse CDFs with the unchanged frozen NumPy proposal, preserving direct artifact compatibility.
decision.fallback_reason: not-required; requested numerical backend live verified.

execution.interface: WSL Python CLI with one OpenBLAS/OMP thread

result.summary: Fixed QMC prototype and 20 toy checks complete. Row quadrature factors include alpha/Nk/R; all MCSEs use independent scramble integrals. Planned scientific row budget is 67520; actual scientific GP calls zero. This completes prototype validation only. Independent numerical review passed seven checks; no stability claim follows.

methods: Deterministic Student and defensive inverse maps and independent full-mixture SciPy density.
Unequal-Nk exact constant-integrand and component-mass identities; complete three-center prior combination.
Same-seed replay and changed-seed point differences; explicit rejection of 0/1 endpoints.
Known constant and bimodal likelihoods; twelve independent eight-scramble experiments with exact CDF integrals.
Per-row logweight identity and no iid-row uncertainty formula.
Budget calculated directly from all frozen full component probabilities including defensive component.
Independent hand-calculated covariance/ratio, 17-fold row splitting invariance, Student map/full-q, alpha/Nk/R, seed/endpoint and center-rho audit: seven checks passed, zero GP calls.
verification.residual_or_error: Final exact toy identities pass <=1e-14. Bimodal truth Z=0.9999376818; outer mean=0.9999500049. Tail truth=0.3498977275; outer mean=0.3499353426. Outer variance/mean reported variance=1.48 and 1.57; small-R SE is approximate.
limitations: No scientific GP likelihood, pilot or stability gate evaluated.
The first sequential-summation attempt is preserved; pairwise summation fixes finite rounding only.
Scramble intervals and ratio delta errors are empirical and cannot certify unseen rare contributions.
All scientific budgets must be compared using realized total row counts, not target_N.
